customMethods.script:
# Operator gate: no logged-in operator -> open the initials popup OVER this screen.
	# Non-blocking: the page still populates behind the modal, and session.custom is
	# reactive, so the operator label/mutations pick up the user with no re-populate.
	if not self.session.custom.appUserId:
		system.perspective.openPopup("mpp-initials", "BlueRidge/Components/Popups/InitialsEntry", params={"popupId": "mpp-initials"}, modal=True, showCloseIcon=False, overlayDismiss=False)

customMethods.name: submitOpen
customMethods.script:
draft = BlueRidge.Common.Util.extractQualifiedValues(self.view.custom.openDraft) or {}
	tool = BlueRidge.Common.Util.extractQualifiedValues(self.view.custom.activeTool) or {}
	cell = BlueRidge.Common.Util.extractQualifiedValues(self.session.custom.cell) or {}
	itemId = draft.get("itemId")
	toolCavityId = draft.get("toolCavityId")
	scannedLtt = draft.get("scannedLtt")
	if not scannedLtt:
		BlueRidge.Common.Notify.toast("Scan a LTT", "Scan or enter the pre-printed LTT before opening a basket.", "warning")
		return None
	if itemId is None:
		BlueRidge.Common.Notify.toast("Select an item", "Pick the part being cast before opening a basket.", "warning")
		return None
	if toolCavityId is None:
		BlueRidge.Common.Notify.toast("Select a cavity", "Pick an active cavity of the mounted tool.", "warning")
		return None
	# Gate (2026-07-06 Jacques, carried over from the old create form): a part with no
	# die-cast operation template on its route cannot run.
	tplId = BlueRidge.Parts.OperationTemplate.getActiveTemplateIdForRoute(itemId, "DieCast")
	if tplId is None:
		BlueRidge.Common.Notify.toast("No operation template", "The route for this part has no die-cast operation template - it cannot run at Die Cast.", "error")
		return None
	term = None
	try:
		term = self.session.custom.terminal.terminalLocationId
	except:
		term = None
	data = {
		"itemId": itemId,
		"currentLocationId": cell.get("locationId"),
		"toolId": tool.get("ToolId"),
		"toolCavityId": toolCavityId,
		"lotName": scannedLtt,
		"appUserId": self.session.custom.appUserId,
		"terminalLocationId": term,
	}
	result = BlueRidge.Lots.Lot.openDieCast(data)
	BlueRidge.Common.Ui.notifyResult(result, successTitle="Basket opened")
	if result and result.get("Status"):
		self.clearOpenDraft()
		self.view.custom.refreshToken = (self.view.custom.refreshToken or 0) + 1
	return result

customMethods.name: clearOpenDraft
customMethods.script:
# Keep the Item selected (fast repeat-opens across cavities); clear only LTT + cavity.
	self.view.custom.openDraft.scannedLtt = ""
	self.view.custom.openDraft.toolCavityId = None
	try:
		self.getChild("MainRow").getChild("TabContainer").getChild("OpenPanel").getChild("LttField").getChild("LttInput").focus()
	except:
		pass

registerShotLoss
customMethods.script:
tool = BlueRidge.Common.Util.extractQualifiedValues(self.view.custom.activeTool) or {}
	toolId = tool.get("ToolId")
	shiftId = self.view.custom.selectedShiftId
	defId = self.view.custom.shotLossDefectCodeId
	qty = BlueRidge.Common.Util.toIntOrNone(self.view.custom.shotLossQty)
	if toolId is None or shiftId is None:
		BlueRidge.Common.Notify.toast("No die/shift", "Mount a tool and select a shift before registering a shot loss.", "warning")
		return
	if not defId or not qty:
		BlueRidge.Common.Notify.toast("Select reason + quantity", "Pick a defect reason and enter a quantity for the shot loss.", "warning")
		return
	term = None
	try:
		term = self.session.custom.terminal.terminalLocationId
	except:
		term = None
	result = BlueRidge.Workorder.DieCast.registerShotLoss(toolId, shiftId, defId, qty, appUserId=self.session.custom.appUserId, terminalLocationId=term)
	BlueRidge.Common.Ui.notifyResult(result, successTitle="Shot loss registered")
	if result and result.get("Status"):
		self.view.custom.shotLossDefectCodeId = None
		self.view.custom.shotLossQty = ""
		self.view.custom.refreshToken = (self.view.custom.refreshToken or 0) + 1

customMethods.name: requestRelease
customMethods.script:
self.view.custom.pendingReleaseLotId = lotId
	self.view.custom.pendingReleaseLotName = lotName or ""
	nm = lotName or ""
	pc = BlueRidge.Common.Util.toIntOrNone(pieceCount) or 0
	mx = BlueRidge.Common.Util.toIntOrNone(maxPieceCount)
	if belowStandard and mx:
		pct = int(round(100.0 * pc / mx))
		title = "Release under-filled basket"
		confirmText = "Release anyway"
		danger = True
		message = "Basket " + nm + " holds only " + str(pc) + " of " + str(mx) + " pc (" + str(pct) + "% of standard basket size). Release under-filled? This closes accumulation and moves it onto its route (Trim IN)."
	else:
		title = "Release basket"
		confirmText = "Release"
		danger = False
		message = "Release basket " + nm + " to storage? This closes accumulation and moves it onto its route (Trim IN)."
	system.perspective.openPopup("mpp-confirm-release",
		"BlueRidge/Components/Popups/ConfirmAction",
		params={"replyMessage": "releaseConfirmResult", "popupId": "mpp-confirm-release",
			"title": title, "confirmText": confirmText, "danger": danger,
			"message": message},
		modal=True, showCloseIcon=True)

customMethods.script:

	if lotId is None:
		return
	term = None
	try:
		term = self.session.custom.terminal.terminalLocationId
	except:
		term = None
	result = BlueRidge.Lots.Lot.voidDieCast(lotId, appUserId=self.session.custom.appUserId, terminalLocationId=term)
	BlueRidge.Common.Ui.notifyResult(result, successTitle="Basket voided")
	if result and result.get("Status"):
		self.view.custom.pendingVoidLotId = None
		self.view.custom.pendingVoidLotName = ""

	self.view.custom.breakdownEntries = {}

customMethods.name: resolveOverflow
customMethods.script:
raw = self.view.custom.pendingSubmit
	ps = system.util.jsonDecode(raw) if raw else None
	if not ps:
		return
	lines = ps.get("lines") or []
	overflow = ps.get("overflow") or []
	shiftId = ps.get("shiftId")
	toolId = ps.get("toolId")
	cellId = ps.get("cellLocationId")
	term = ps.get("terminalLocationId")
	gross = ps.get("grossShots")
	appUserId = self.session.custom.appUserId
	if action == "cancel":
		self.view.custom.pendingSubmit = ""
		return
	decisions = BlueRidge.Common.Util.extractQualifiedValues(decisions) or {}
	def _dec(lotId):
		dd = decisions.get("%s" % lotId)
		if dd is None:
			dd = decisions.get(lotId)
		dd = BlueRidge.Common.Util.extractQualifiedValues(dd) or {}
		return (dd.get("mode") or "fill"), ("%s" % (dd.get("ltt") or "")).strip()
	overLotIds = set(o.get("lotId") for o in overflow)
	overfillIds = set(o.get("lotId") for o in overflow if _dec(o.get("lotId"))[0] == "overfill")
	batch = [ln for ln in lines if (ln.get("lotId") not in overLotIds) or (ln.get("lotId") in overfillIds)]
	if batch:
		r0 = BlueRidge.Workorder.DieCast.recordShiftOutput({"shiftId": shiftId, "toolId": toolId, "lines": batch, "shotLoss": []}, appUserId=appUserId, terminalLocationId=term, cellLocationId=cellId)
		BlueRidge.Common.Ui.notifyResult(r0, successTitle="Cavities recorded")
		if not (r0 and r0.get("Status")):
			return
	for o in overflow:
		lotId = o.get("lotId")
		mode, ltt = _dec(lotId)
		if mode != "fill":
			continue
		rel = BlueRidge.Lots.Lot.releaseDieCast({"lotId": lotId, "finalPieceDelta": o.get("headroom"), "scrapLines": o.get("scrapLines") or [], "shiftId": shiftId, "appUserId": appUserId, "terminalLocationId": term})
		BlueRidge.Common.Ui.notifyResult(rel, successTitle="Basket " + (o.get("lotName") or "") + " filled + released")
		if not (rel and rel.get("Status")):
			return
		opened = BlueRidge.Lots.Lot.openDieCast({"itemId": o.get("itemId"), "currentLocationId": cellId, "toolId": toolId, "toolCavityId": o.get("toolCavityId"), "lotName": ltt, "appUserId": appUserId, "terminalLocationId": term})
		BlueRidge.Common.Ui.notifyResult(opened, successTitle="New basket " + ltt + " opened")
		if not (opened and opened.get("Status")):
			return
		newLot = opened.get("NewId")
		rem = BlueRidge.Workorder.DieCast.recordShiftOutput({"shiftId": shiftId, "toolId": toolId, "lines": [{"lotId": newLot, "pieceDelta": o.get("remainder"), "scrapLines": []}], "shotLoss": []}, appUserId=appUserId, terminalLocationId=term, cellLocationId=cellId)
		BlueRidge.Common.Ui.notifyResult(rem, successTitle="Remainder recorded to " + ltt)
		if not (rem and rem.get("Status")):
			return
	if gross:
		BlueRidge.Workorder.DieCast.recordShiftOutput({"shiftId": shiftId, "toolId": toolId, "lines": [], "shotLoss": [], "grossShots": gross}, appUserId=appUserId, terminalLocationId=term, cellLocationId=cellId)
	self._afterSubmit()
